_about: Assigned abilities (COMBAT_ENGINE_PLAN.md 3.4a): the non-magical twin of assigned spells. One entry per ability; tools/gen_abilities.js writes the ability_facts_load lookup in web/mygame/scenes/combat_abilities.txt from it. kind is one of attack_variant, action, extra_attack, on_hit_rider, trait. uses is a number per fight, or "unlimited".

multiattack.name: Multiattack
multiattack.desc: After its first melee attack, a second, lighter strike at the same attack bonus: a d4, with no special move. (Captain Trent's long blade and knife.)
